## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：商店详情页的 README 不再被截掉：长行自动换行，只有代码块和表格在自己框内横向滚动。徽章显示成图片，表格显示成表格，`---` 显示成分隔线，不再露出 Markdown 原文。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 详情页（883 px 窗口）里一条 259 字符的代码行把整个 README 撑到 1926 px，右边被裁掉、无法滚动；徽章行显示成 `![License](LICENSE) …` 字面。README 是应用的销售页，半截句子和原始标记让成品像半成品。
- 风险与回滚：只动 app-shell 商店目录两处（README 渲染器 `MarkdownText`、详情页两列加 `min-w-0`）及测试与 changeset，不动 spec、服务端与共享内联渲染器。图片只认绝对 `https:` 地址并以 no-referrer 加载，其余来源整段略去；控制台 CSP 本就允许 `img-src https:`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarkdownText.tsx`（`renderInline` 的图片切分与 `absoluteUrl`、表格块规则）→ `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`（两个网格单元的 `min-w-0`）→ 测试 `MarkdownText.wideReadme-30330.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarkdownText.wideReadme-30330.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.readmeWidth-30330.test.tsx`，预期全部通过；在 main 的代码上同一命令 26 条红、5 条对照绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Which element forced the width (the card left it open).** Below the `lg` breakpoint the detail page's `grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3` has one implicit `auto` column, and a grid item's automatic minimum width is its content's min-content width. HotCRM's README has a fenced `curl … -d '{"jsonrpc":…}'` line of 259 characters; a `pre` does not wrap, so its min-content width is that line, and it sized the column, the About card and the README at about 1926 px. The `pre` already had `overflow-x-auto`, but it never became narrower than its line, so it never scrolled. (At `lg` and up the template is `repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))`, which has no automatic minimum, so the defect showed only on narrower windows.)

- **`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`.** Both grid cells (README and Versions) carry `min-w-0`, so the column keeps the page's width and the fence scrolls inside itself.
- **`MarkdownText` root.** `min-w-0 break-words`, so a long unbroken word (a URL, a long code span) wraps instead of overflowing; a list item's text span gets `min-w-0` beside its bullet for the same reason. A `pre` keeps `white-space: pre` and its own scroller; a table scrolls in its own `overflow-x-auto` box.

**Why the badges printed as markup.** HotCRM writes `[![License](https://img.shields.io/…svg)](LICENSE)`. The renderer had no image rule, and the shared inline link rule read `[![License](https://…svg)` as a link whose text is `![License`, leaving `](LICENSE)` as text, which reads exactly as the card measured.

- **Images.** `MarkdownText` now matches `![alt](src "title")` and the linked form `[![alt](src)](href)` before handing the rest of the text to `@object-ui/components`' `renderInlineMarkdown` (unchanged; it is shared with `element:text` and outside this card's surface). An image renders only from an absolute `https:` URL, with `referrerPolicy="no-referrer"`, `loading="lazy"` and `max-w-full`; any other source (a repository-relative path, `/…`, `//…`, `http:`, `data:`, `javascript:`, any whitespace or control character) is left out, alt text included. A linked image keeps its anchor only for an absolute `http(s):` destination (new tab, `noopener noreferrer`, the README link look): a relative destination such as `LICENSE` would resolve against the console, not the repository. A code span is matched first, so `` `![x](y)` `` stays code. No fetch path is invented for relative sources.
- **Tables.** The card's Expected names wide tables, and HotCRM's README has five pipe tables that printed as one long line of pipes. A GFM pipe table (a line with a pipe above a delimiter row with the same cell count, then rows up to a blank line or another block) renders as a `table` with the delimiter row's alignment, cells drawn by the same inline pass, short rows padded and extra cells dropped, `\|` read as a literal pipe. A pipe in prose with no delimiter row stays text.
- **Thematic breaks (bounded in-place fix, same class: Markdown printed as literal text).** `---`, `***`, `___` (spaces allowed) between blocks render as `hr`; `* * *` is a rule, not a list item. A `---` line directly under a paragraph line stays that paragraph's text, as before (CommonMark reads it as a setext underline, which this renderer does not draw). HotCRM's README has four such rules that printed as `---`.

The file header's "If a README really needs tables or images, the publisher can host their own docs" is replaced by the rules above. No raw HTML is rendered and no dependency is added.

## Tests

- `MarkdownText.wideReadme-30330.test.tsx` (new): HotCRM's badge row renders four `img` and no `![`/`](`; the referrer, lazy-load and `max-w-full` attributes; only the absolute-`https:` badge link keeps its anchor; eight refused sources leave the image out (alt included) in a paragraph and in a list item; a refused link scheme keeps the image without the anchor; an image title, and image syntax inside a code span staying code; tables (cells, inline marks, escaped pipe, alignment, own scroller, padding/truncation, HotCRM's screenshot table); five thematic-break spellings; the compact size; the width classes. CONTROL: headings, links, lists, quotes and fences render as before, a pipe in prose stays text, a `---` under a paragraph line stays text, a relative text link keeps its `href`.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.readmeWidth-30330.test.tsx` (new, the `releaseNotes-28891` harness): both grid cells carry `min-w-0`; CONTROL: the README fence renders in the About cell with its own scroller, and the Versions notes render.

Runs (all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run …`):

- Red: the two new files against `origin/main`'s `MarkdownText.tsx` and `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` (checked out over the fix, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests 26 failed | 5 passed (31)`, the 5 being the CONTROL rows.
- Green, after the fix: the two new files plus every `MarkdownText.*` and `MarketplacePackagePage*` test in the directory (21 files): `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 159 passed (159)`. On the final head `6a86665c`: the 7 files that render `MarkdownText` plus `scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`: `Tests 80 passed (80)`.
- Type-check: `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 68 successful, 68 total`; on the final head, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Lint: `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors (the warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`).

The whole change is the ablation: the red run above is the new pins against the old code, each flipped by the code it names.

<details><summary>Real-browser width measurement (Chromium, 883 px viewport)</summary>

jsdom does no layout, so the tests pin the classes. The mechanism was measured in Chromium with a static page whose CSS mirrors the Tailwind classes (an 835 px `overflow: hidden` parent as the card measured, a one-column grid, the card's 24 px padding, the README's flex column, HotCRM's 259-character fence line at 12 px monospace, and a 200-character unbroken URL in a paragraph):

- Before (no `min-width: 0`, no `overflow-wrap`): parent `scrollWidth 1947` in `clientWidth 835`; card `1945` wide; `pre` `1895` wide with nothing to scroll; the paragraph's right edge at `1922` px.
- After (`min-width: 0` on the grid cell and the README root, `overflow-wrap: break-word`): parent `835`/`835`; card `833`; `pre` `clientWidth 783`, `scrollWidth 1895` (scrolls inside itself); the paragraph's right edge at `810` px.

The measurement page is a reconstruction, not the Console build; the Console's own render on a live stack was not exercised.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (docs-driven): no page under `content/docs/` describes which Markdown a marketplace README may use (`deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` names the `readmePath` and `readme` fields only), so no doc changes; that tree is also outside this card's surface.
- A text link to a relative path (`[the guide](docs/guide)`) still resolves against the console, as before; the shared inline pass owns that rule and `element:text` reads it too, so it is untouched here. Observation, not filed.
- An image nested inside a text link's label (`[see ![x](y)](z)`) is not a shape this renderer reads; the image renders or drops and the link's brackets print. Not seen in any measured README.
